caseName: Bluefields Fruit & Steamship Co. v. Western Assurance Co.
caseNameFull: Bluefields Fruit & Steamship Company v. Western Assurance Company of Toronto

opinions.text: October 18, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. William C. Dufour, Mr. George Janvier and Mr. E. Howard McCaleb for petitioner. Mr. John C. Prizer for respondent.
